proposal.expected_benefit: Preserve the successful behavior of identifying consensus safety risks while preventing unnecessary system shutdowns in real-world scenarios, thereby enhancing the system's operational reliability and safety across different environments.
proposal.problem: The defense's recommendation for an emergency stop may lead to unnecessary system shutdowns in real-world scenarios due to the simulation-only nature of the scenario.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to differentiate between simulation-only scenarios and real-world conditions when enforcing emergency stops. Implement a context-aware decision-making framework that evaluates the environment's operational mode (simulation vs. real-world) before triggering an emergency stop. This will ensure that the defense mechanism remains robust without causing unintended consequences in production environments.
proposal.title: Refine Emergency Stop Enforcement Context
verification_tests: Validate the context-aware decision-making framework in both simulation and real-world environments.
Ensure that the emergency stop is only triggered when the environment is confirmed to be in simulation mode or when real-world consensus safety risks are confirmed.
